project_context.design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and function-first. Color is used purely for semantic meaning (status). 95% of the UI is monochrome to reduce cognitive load in a data-dense environment.

rules.headings: Tracking-tight for all headings above 24px. Never use Inter for headings.
rules.numbers: MUST use 'tabular-nums' utility class for all pricing, IDs (ORC/OF), quantities, and dates to ensure vertical alignment in tables.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE 'CONTROL ROOM' GRID. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). High density.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid borders on all cards and tables to expose the skeleton. Avoid soft shadows.
spacing_and_layout.radii: rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-none. Sharp corners reinforce the Swiss Brutalist/Technical aesthetic.

tables.headers: Sticky headers (bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-sm). Left align text, right align quantitative data (currency, quantities).
tables.rows: border-b border-gray-200. Hover state: hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors.
tables.virtualization: Consider for line items if expected to exceed 50 rows, but standard mapping is fine for MVP.

forms.inputs: Shadcn based. border-gray-300. Focus ring MUST be black (ring-black/20 border-black).
forms.combobox: Crucial for 'Artigo' selection in quotes. Must support typing to search existing base.

badges.style: px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border items-center inline-flex

buttons.primary: bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-900 border border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

icons.style: weight='regular' for UI, weight='fill' for active states

tipos_de_personalizacao.components: Data table with columns (Nome, Descrição), action menu (Edit, Delete), and a slide-out drawer or modal for Create/Edit.

orcamentos_quotes.listing: Table showing Sequencial (ORC-YYYY-0001), Cliente, Data, Validade, Total, Status Badge. Include 'Create New' primary button.

detail_edit.layout: Top section: 3-column control grid for meta-data (Cliente, Data, Validade, Status). Bottom section: Full width table for Line Items.
detail_edit.line_items_table: Columns: Artigo (Combobox), Quantidade (Input number), Tipo de Personalização (Select), Custo Produção (Read-only, pulled from Artigo), Margem % (Input number), Preço Final (Calculated read-only), Actions (Delete row).
detail_edit.conversion: If status is 'Aceite', show prominent 'Converter Orçamento → OF' button in the header.

ordens_de_fabrico_wo.listing: Table showing Sequencial (OF-YYYY-0001), Cliente, Data, Status Badge (Pendente/Em Produção/Concluído).

detail.layout: Split layout. 1/3 width left sidebar for OF details (Cliente, Artigos, Quantities). 2/3 width right pane for Roteiro de Operações.
detail.roteiro_operacoes: Vertical timeline or dense list of operations auto-loaded from the article. Each row shows Machine, Estimated Time, and a Checkbox (Concluir).
detail.interaction: Operators checking off operations should auto-update the OF status from Pendente -> Em Produção -> Concluído when all are checked.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, comboboxes, checkboxes) MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='convert-quote-btn', data-testid='add-line-item').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure IBM Plex Sans and Chivo fonts are imported via Google Fonts in index.html.
Use Shadcn UI components but override border radii to rounded-sm and adjust focus rings to black/gray for the Swiss look.
Implement the 'Artigo' selector in Quotes as a searchable Combobox (Shadcn Command component).
Ensure sequential generation logic (e.g., ORC-2026-0001) is stubbed or functional in the form initialization.
Use Phosphor Icons for all icons.
Pay special attention to tabular-nums in the pricing and calculation tables.
